_comment: Example config for run_pipeline.py on tokenizer sample v0. Paths are relative to the repository root. clean, overlap and dedup are TSAI jobs: 'adopt' points at the folders TSAI returned. To run a stage here instead, use its '_run_example': a settings file (settings only, no paths) and, for clean, the raw sample; the runner works out the folders (inside the run folder) and hands each script its paths. 'python run_pipeline.py --config <this file> --plan' prints every folder and command without running anything.

f2._workers: parallel run_f2.py processes, one per pack folder; each needs about 1.1 GB of memory

apply._link: hard-link untouched parts instead of copying them (same file system)

_shards_example._note: rename to 'shards' to add the shard stage after survivor loss; 'packs' limits it to packs with a lane in shards/pack_table.json
